title: SYNECS three-day higher-education warning strike
reason: Excluded as a workplace/academic activity stoppage: reviewed evidence describes cessation of academic and research work, not a public protest gathering; no public attendance figure or meeting documented.
notes: The union's grievances are directed toward government policy/employment conditions, but strike participation cannot be substituted for public demonstrator turnout. S002 reproduces SYNECS communiqué; reports are not independent proof of attendance.
